verdict.rationale: LM Studio's CLI docs explicitly list `lms server start` and `lms server stop` under "Start and stop the local server". The headless llmster daemon and Local LLM Service mode back up server operation without the GUI, and a community user praises the headless flow. missing for 10: in-depth docs on server start/stop options (port, network binding, status), independent hands-on corroboration of the CLI start/stop commands specifically.
